paper_statement: Geo-NeW exactly preserves discrete conservation structure through Whitney forms and FEEC.
assumptions: The discrete operators use the oriented incidence construction implemented by Geo-NeW.
The Whitney partition of unity and exact-sequence construction are not replaced by a learned unconstrained operator.

checks: delta_0 @ 1 is integer-exact zero for P in [3,4,5,8,12]
1^T delta_0^T F is zero for 150 seeded random fluxes
the independent incidence implementation agrees with the implementation under test

rejection_rule: Any failed identity, independent cross-check, or negative control exits nonzero.
